entities.name: Methyl ester hydrolysis
observations: The input-to-output change is conversion of a methyl ester, R-C(=O)-OCH3, to the carboxylic acid, R-C(=O)-OH; the remaining scaffold appears unchanged.
Likely transformation class is ester saponification or ester hydrolysis.

entities.name: Aqueous base hydrolysis
observations: Representative conditions are LiOH, NaOH, or KOH in aqueous alcohol or water, followed by acidic workup.
LiOH in THF/water or MeOH/water is commonly selected for chemoselective methyl ester hydrolysis.

entities.name: Acidic ester hydrolysis
observations: Alternative conditions include aqueous HCl or H2SO4, often with heating; these are less preferred when acid-sensitive groups are present.
